hooks.name: Update data-sources.md after a pipeline change
hooks.description: Keeps the data-sources steering file and the provenance registry in step with the pipeline.

action.prompt:
A pipeline file changed. Check whether it added, removed or renamed any field written to public/data/hexes.json. For every change:

1. Add or update the entry in pipeline/sources.py — both SOURCES (name, publisher, url, landing_page, vintage, license, status, caveat) and FIELD_SOURCES (source id plus verified/modeled/proxy/unavailable).
2. Add the field to the table in .kiro/steering/data-sources.md with its source, status and caveat.
3. Add the field to HexRecord in lib/types.ts and to the decoder in lib/hexes.ts.
4. Confirm the field is never given a favourable default when the source has no value.

Then run `npx vitest run`; the calibration test asserts every field with data names a verified source. Report what you changed.
